name: Montana Black & Brown Storage Dining Table

dimensions.source: The page's Description tab, Overall Dimension row, read in Chrome 2026-11-10 with the Black & Brown finish selected. Bob's W is the long side (w), D is across (d).

notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10, after the first ranking: "I want it at least 72" long. I don' want the ends to block guests' feet ,I hate that" (F-60). RANKED 2 of 3 on Bob's under that rule: the best room fit of the corner-legged tables, black legs under a brown top, table only. Flags: tight:29 (F-36). Fit (dining-room, 98 x 89 between the two walkways, F-42): along the room's depth, 40" across leaves 29" a side; set 1" toward the kitchen, the wall side gets its 30" and the kitchen side 28" to the walkway's edge. 72" long, 17" to the bottom wall: three chairs a side between its four tapered legs, which stand at the corners (its photos), no end seat. "six conveniently located storage drawers" with dovetail joints and drawer glides; the drawers sit in the apron along the long sides, so sit at it in the store to check knee room under them. Chairs are not included: the black Montana 6 Piece Upholstered Dining Set with Storage Bench is $999.00 on the collection carousel (not opened). Color (F-68 (10)): Finish Group Black, black base and legs under a brown oak-veneer top with a rustic plank look in a framed border (its photos): dark on the white marble, the brown top a sibling of the living room's walnut UGGLERUM (F-68 (2)). Rustic; rubberwood solids, MDF, plywood, oak veneers. 2,549 reviews. "Bob's Everyday Low Price" $599.00, not marked down. Get it as soon as Nov 13 (to 11101); some assembly required; see it in person at the Long Island City store. The same table in Espresso & White is other-bobs-20060998. Returns (Bob's Returns tab, 2026-11-10): an order cancels for a full refund until delivery or pickup day; after delivery Bob's takes furniture back only for factory defects. See it in person before ordering. No photo: Bob's images are on res.cloudinary.com/mybobs/, which catalog:image refuses until Andrew allows that folder.
